mainEntity.name: How do I test whether an AI data analyst gives correct answers before rolling it out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Write down real questions your team asked last month, with every answer you would accept for each. Run them against your AI analyst before rollout, then again on a schedule or when something it depends on changes.

mainEntity.name: We tested it and it was fine. Why is it worse three months later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anthropic reports that its offline accuracy drifted "from ~95% at launch to ~65% over a month before we treated this as an engineering problem."

mainEntity.name: How do I keep measuring accuracy after launch, not just at evaluation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anthropic, Uber, Hex, GitHub and Salesforce re-run their tests on a change, before each deploy, or daily.

mainEntity.name: How do I run accuracy checks automatically when definitions change?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anthropic re-runs the affected evals in CI when a PR touches a dependency.
